title: B-tree cursor payload file offset

scope.rationale: sqlite3BtreeOffset returns the database-file byte offset at which the current cell payload begins: page size times zero-based page number plus the payload offset within the page.

external_source_responsibilities: Caller-held cursor mutex and populated CellInfo
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete offset arithmetic is assigned; cell-info population and public consumers remain open.

inputs: Valid Cursor under its B-tree mutex, with current page and payload_offset populated
contracts.ownership: Borrowed cursor/page state; no allocation or mutation.
contracts.state_and_results: Uses physical page size, one-based page number converted to zero-based, and payload offset within current page.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller holds cursor B-tree mutex; no callbacks or I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Invalid state or missing page violates source/model assertions; valid state is total.

representation_differences: The Zig CellInfo.payload_offset is already relative to page start for the model owner, corresponding to pCell+aData offset in source.
Typed pageSize helper replaces direct BtShared.pageSize access.

oracle.protocol: Use page 2 of a 4,096-byte format with payload offset 7 and compare absolute offset 4,103.

assurance.continuation: Pure observation leaves cursor state unchanged.

integration.native_call_path: Typed arithmetic and nonzero-page trace exist; payload consumers remain pending.

independent_review.notes: Requires cell-info/caller integration, pinned-C trace, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Connect source-shaped CellInfo population on cursor positioning.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/btree.c:4919-4951 was reviewed completely for integer key, pin, and payload offset context
callers: Unit trace invokes the owner directly
callees: Typed pageSize owner corresponding to direct source field read
assertions_branches_cleanup: Both source assertions and return block are assigned
upstream_tests: Upstream incremental-blob, payload, page-size, and overflow tests cover this offset
Project unit trace covers page 2 plus nonzero payload offset
